# Quickstart Resources

> MCP クイックスタート用のサンプルリポジトリ。複数言語（Python・TypeScript・Go・Rust・Ruby）による MCP クライアントおよびウェザーサーバーの実装例を収録し、MCP プロトコルの基本的な使い方を示す。

---

## Source Modules

### mcp-client-python.client

*Source: mcp-client-python/client.py | URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/quickstart-resources/blob/main/mcp-client-python/client.py*

- `MCPClient`
- `anthropic`: Lazy-initialize Anthropic client when needed
- `connect_to_server`: Connect to an MCP server
- `process_query`: Process a query using Claude and available tools
- `chat_loop`: Run an interactive chat loop
- `cleanup`: Clean up resources
- `main`

### weather-server-python.weather

*Source: weather-server-python/weather.py | URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/quickstart-resources/blob/main/weather-server-python/weather.py*

- `make_nws_request`: Make a request to the NWS API with proper error handling.
- `format_alert`: Format an alert feature into a readable string.
- `get_alerts`: Get weather alerts for a US state.
- `get_forecast`: Get weather forecast for a location.
- `main`
